short.en: Are you free this Saturday? We could catch up over dinner.
short.zh: 这周六有空吗？我们可以约顿饭叙叙旧。
short.note: catch up 叙旧；over dinner 边吃晚饭边。

short.en: Just as courage imperils life, fear protects it.
He kept glancing at his phone while she was trying to explain the problem.
short.zh: 她努力解释问题时，他却一直瞟手机。
short.note: keep doing 持续做；glance at 瞥一眼。

short.en: The end of life is to be like god, and the soul following god will be like him.
I'm just comparing prices before I decide which one to buy.
short.zh: 我先比比价，再决定买哪件。
short.note: compare prices 比价；which one to buy 疑问词+不定式。

short.en: I'm not a morning person, so I need a few minutes to wake up.
short.zh: 我不是早起型的人，得缓几分钟才能清醒。
short.note: morning person 习惯早起的人；wake up 醒来。

short.en: It looks like it's going to rain later, so bring an umbrella just in case.
short.zh: 看样子稍后要下雨，带把伞以防万一。
short.note: look like 看起来；just in case 以防万一。

short.en: Champions are not generated from the championship. Champion is generated from something they have in them, desires, dreams, and visions.
Please find the attached report for your reference.
short.note: attached 重音在第二音节；reference 重音在前。

short.en: If they wrote it to make money, don't read it.
To be, or not to be, that is the question.
short.zh: 生存还是毁灭，这是一个值得思考的问题。
short.note: 莎剧名句；question 重音在前；朗读时在逗号处停顿。

short.en: I'm having a hard time following the lecture.
short.zh: 我有点跟不上这个讲座。
short.note: have a hard time doing 是固定搭配；following 注意 /l/。

short.en: They moved to a quieter neighborhood after their first child was born.
short.zh: 第一个孩子出生后，他们搬到了更安静的街区。
short.note: was born 被动；quieter 比较级。

short.en: It's up to you, I don't mind.
short.note: up to you 连读；mind 的 /d/ 尾音轻收。

short.en: Don't stop when you're tired. Stop when you're done.
God doesn't require us to succeed, he only requires that you try.
Nobody told me the meeting had been moved.
short.zh: 没人告诉我会议改时间了。
short.note: had been moved 被动完成；meeting 双音节。

short.en: Can we talk about this later? I'm kind of busy right now.
short.zh: 这事能晚点说吗？我现在有点忙。
short.note: kind of 口语弱读；later 的 /t/ 轻触。

short.en: You should stop worrying about what they say.
short.zh: 你别再管他们说什么了。
short.note: stop doing 停止做；worry about 固定搭配。

short.en: Get busy living, or get busy dying.

long.en: Changing a habit is rarely easy, and most people fail several times before a new routine sticks. The key is to start with one small step, forgive yourself when you slip, and keep going rather than giving up after a single mistake.
long.zh: 改变习惯很少容易，大多数人在新习惯固定下来之前会失败好几次。关键是从小步开始，失手时原谅自己，继续坚持，而不是一次出错就放弃。
long.note: routine 重音在第二音节；sticks 此处指“固定下来”；slip 小过失。

long.en: On weekends I usually wake up around eight, make myself a cup of coffee, and sit by the window to plan the day. I like to read for a while, then go for a long walk in the park where I can watch people and dogs passing by.
long.zh: 周末我通常八点左右醒，给自己泡杯咖啡，坐在窗边规划一天。我会先读会儿书，再去公园散步，看行人和小狗经过。
long.note: 按意群在逗号处停顿；where 引导定语从句；passing by 现在分词作伴随。

long.en: Is life so dear, or peace so sweet, as to be purchased at the price of chains and slavery? I know not what course others may take; but as for me, give me liberty, or give me death!
long.zh: 生命果真如此宝贵，和平果真如此甜美，竟值得以枷锁和奴役为代价吗？我不知道别人会如何选择；至于我，不自由，毋宁死。
long.note: 问句语调上扬；chains and slavery 连读；结尾 give me liberty, or give me death 逐词加重。

a. 苦的, 痛苦的, 怀恨的
n. 外科医生, 军医, 船医
a. 艺术的, 艺术家的, 富有艺术性的
